Known for its popular drive-thru holiday light display, Shady Brook Farm gets into the harvest fest-spooky season mashup, too, with this festival, featuring corn mazes, pumpkin picking, wagon rides, Halloween lights, live music and more.

Daytime means access to old-fashioned fun across more than 25 activities, like a playground, slides, gem mining and tons more. Evenings transform the farm into the Eerie Illuminations Halloween Light Show — a fright-free wagon ride through the lighted woods.
